The diaper itself shows signs of use or staining (pink/purple discoloration) and has visible elastic leg gathers.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The added fabric items (hat, animals) appear to melt into the diaper surface without clear physical attachment mechanisms like pins, glue, or stitching. The boundaries between the 'decorations' and the diaper are soft and indistinct, suggesting AI generation blending textures rather than physical objects placed on top.

The pink/purple stains have a smeared, painterly quality rather than realistic liquid absorption patterns. The texture of the diaper material lacks the fine granular detail of real non-woven fabric, appearing slightly waxy or smoothed.
The hat lacks a rigid structure or clear seam lines; it appears as a soft, amorphous blob of patterned fabric rather than a constructed cone shape.
